---
title: "<Firm Name> TRA"
# Multi-TRA firms: "<Firm Name> TRA (<TRA-id>)"
# Beneficiary-side files: "<Firm Name> TRA (<role> at <obligor>)"
author: "tra-build-timeline skill"
date: <YYYY-MM-DD>  # date this file was written
company-names: ["<Firm 1>"]
# All public-company entities involved. Duplicates allowed when one CIK had multiple names across its life
# (SPAC rename, post-merger rename). One entry per name; CIKs list mirrors order one-to-one.
CIKs: ["0001234567"]
# Always quote each CIK string to preserve leading zeros. Same order as company-names.
status: Ongoing  # Ongoing | Terminated | Unknown
creation-date: <YYYY-MM-DD>  # TRA execution date
termination-date:
# Blank when status is Ongoing or Unknown. YYYY-MM-DD when Terminated.
tax-asset-type: [Basis Step-Up]
# ALWAYS a list, even with one entry. One or more of: Basis Step-Up, NOL, Other tax credit.
# Capital losses are tagged NOL. Section 197 amortization is tagged Basis Step-Up.
sharing-ratio: "85%"
# Simple percent string. Aggregate caps, per-tranche structure, et cetera go in `notes`.
parallel-tras: []
# Always present. List other TRA IDs at this firm; empty list when this is the only TRA.
role: PubCo
# PubCo | Beneficiary | Acquirer | Financing-arm
trigger-event-type: IPO
# IPO | Asset purchase | Merger | SPAC business combination | Plan of reorganization |
# Spin-off | Up-C transition | Section 162 issuance | JV formation | Other
counterparty-type: pre-IPO holders
# Optional. pre-IPO holders | M&A sellers | founder vehicle | named individual |
# transfer-agent book-entry | plan-of-reorganization trustee | Other
notes:
# Optional. Maximum 3 lines. Use for aggregate caps, per-tranche structures, off-EDGAR docket pointers,
# valuation-allowance quirks, predecessor-name notes for shared CIKs. Longer narrative goes in Explanation.
---

## TRA Timeline

#### <Origination phase grouping>

- <YYYY-MM-DD>: <one-line description of the operative event>

#### <Material event grouping (only if a material event occurred)>

- <YYYY-MM-DD>: <one-line description>

#### <Termination phase grouping (only if status is Terminated)>

- <YYYY-MM-DD>: <one-line description>

## Explanation

<Three to five sentences. Lead with the trigger event and the contract's economic
terms; cover any material amendments; close with the end-of-life state. End with
"See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.">
